title: Open Mic @ RiverCity Rock Star Academy
event_description: Last Friday of every month open mic for all musicians. Free all ages event with professional stage setup welcoming solo artists bands and all styles. Two hours of performances from local talent.
event_venue_information:
RiverCity Rock Star Academy

Salem's premiere music destination and live performance venue since 2015 located in South Salem. The academy features a professional Garage Stage with full backline equipment including drums amplifiers and PA system. Home to the acclaimed End of the Month Open Mic held last Friday of each month from 7-9 PM. The venue welcomes musicians of all ages and skill levels to perform original music covers and diverse styles. Also hosts student preview shows and performance-based music education programs including blues ensembles for teens and adults.

Music Events

Regular open mic nights showcase local talent ranging from solo acoustic performers to full electric bands and poetry. The venue provides a supportive low-pressure environment for musicians testing new material or performing for their first time.

title: Open Mic @ The Triangle Tavern
event_description: Weekly open mic nights on Wednesdays. Diverse mix of original and cover music with full entertainment lineup. Community-focused dive bar with live music seven days a week.
event_venue_information:
The Triangle Tavern

Historic 60+ year old Salem venue recently remodeled featuring a brand new stage and kitchen. Located on Liberty Road South the tavern offers music seven days a week from open mic jams to solo acoustic to full electric performances. Known for attracting regional and local artists from diverse genres. Features a large covered outdoor area with fire pit making it ideal for gatherings even in bad weather. The venue maintains a relaxed welcoming atmosphere with friendly bartenders and offers affordable bar food including popular beer-battered fries and nachos.

Entertainment Features

Open Mic Jams are a weekly staple drawing local musicians. The venue has hosted notable acts including Pigeon John Ty Curtis Sandbox Almost Friday and many regional performers. DJ nights and engaging entertainment round out the weekly schedule.

title: Live Music @ Taproot Lounge & Cafe
event_description: Live music performances Friday and Saturday evenings in historic downtown 1860 building. Showcasing regional musical talent in intimate 21+ venue with craft cocktails and farm-to-table food.
event_venue_information:
Taproot Lounge & Cafe

Established 2015 in a historic 1860s downtown Salem building featuring a full stage and live music program. The venue supports local farms local businesses and provides an outlet for musicians and artists to perform and display their talents. Open 7 days a week with breakfast service transition to lounge at night. Features a juice bar fresh vegetable and fruit offerings full breakfast menu light healthy meals tapas desserts and specialty coffees and teas. Full bar with crafty cocktails and craft beer selection. Friday and Saturday evenings feature live music showcasing some of the region's top musical talent in an intimate setting.

Music Programming

Regular live music nights support local musicians and regional acts. The cafe maintains a hip but easygoing vibe attracting musicians and music lovers to downtown Salem.

title: Live Music @ Honky Tonk Bar & Grill
event_description: Live music every weekend with line dancing lessons and karaoke. High-energy country venue featuring local and regional bands. Salem's largest bar with consistent live entertainment.
event_venue_information:
Honky Tonk Bar & Grill

Salem's largest bar specializing in country music and entertainment. Features live music every weekend with a strong lineup of local and regional bands. The venue offers a vibrant atmosphere with high-energy performances and regular entertainment options. Houses a full bar with high-end whiskey selection and Southern-influenced menu featuring BBQ ribs fried chicken burgers tacos and mac and cheese. Themed events are hosted on the last Friday of every month providing extra excitement and entertainment variety.

Entertainment Features

Beyond live music the venue offers line dancing lessons karaoke nights and themed events. Known for good consistent live music making it one of the few Salem venues with reliable weekend entertainment programming.

title: Live Music @ Venti's Cafe & Beer Vault
event_description: Occasional live music events in the underground Beer Vault. Craft beer focused venue with event space available for private parties and special programming. Upstairs street-level casual dining with basement bar venue.
event_venue_information:
Venti's Cafe & Beer Vault

Salem institution since 1996 featuring street-level fast-casual plant-based protein forward dining with basement bar venue. The Beer Vault underground bar provides event space for private parties and special programming. Established as pioneer of plant-based proteins with clean hormone and antibiotic-free meats and poultry. Full-service catering available in-house or off-site. The Vault space is available for private parties with custom food and drink suggestions.

Music & Events

The Beer Vault serves as an event space with curated craft beer offerings from exclusive selections. The venue maintains a community-focused atmosphere supporting local artists and musicians.
